newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga-led group wins Irish operatorship.
newsitem.headline: Saga-led group wins Irish operatorship.

text.p: A consortium led by Norway's largest listed oil company, Saga Petroleum ASA, was awarded an operatorship for oil exploration in the Rockall Trough area west of Ireland, according to a statement on the Oslo bourse.
The consortium also included Total, Shell and state Norwegian oil company Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil ).
The licence encompasses four blocks in varying water depths of between 1,000 to 3,000 metres, the statement said.
"With a 40 percent (interest) in Slyne Trough and the new award, Saga has become one of the central players on the Irish continental shelf," it said.
The company added that it was too early to say when drilling would begin.
